task.prompt: A complete friendly compact humanoid workshop robot, standing upright in an A-pose. Large rounded rectangular head, cream ceramic faceplate and two inset circular glass eyes, dark blue enamel torso and limb shells, brushed copper joint collars. Clear separate arms, elbows, wrists, three-finger hands, hips, knees and broad rounded feet. Small chest access panel, subtle real screws and seams, backpack-like battery housing. Premium animated-film craftsmanship, believable thickness and soft beveled edges. No fur, no weapons, no logos, no writing, no base or props. Full body, all limbs intact, symmetrical mechanical construction.
task.texture_prompt: Premium animated-film robot. Painted deep blue enamel shell, brushed copper joints, cream ceramic faceplate, dark inset glass eyes with cyan centers. Real seams, fasteners and rounded manufactured edges; subtly worn but clean. No animal fur, no logos, text, pedestal or floating props.
